name: Fan belonging to Julia Neilson
material: wood; lacquer; gold paint; paper; paint; metal; wood; satin
dimensions: Height 28 cm; Width 49.5 cm; Height 29.3 cm; Height 28 cm
summary: Fan used by Julia Neilson (1868-1957) as Nell Gwyn in the play Sweet Nell of Old Drury, Haymarket Theatre, 1900, and as Lady Blakeney in the stage version of The Scarlet Pimpernel, New Theatre, 1905, with original box.
